links.outcome: Demographic and stereotyped patterns in generated depression videos (age, gender, isolation)
links.effect: 88% (323/367) of figures were aged 20-30 years and 98% (360/367) were alone; gender skewed male in app outputs (68%) and female in API outputs (59%); 94% seated figures, 93% downward gaze.
links.quote: Figures were predominantly young adults (323/367, 88% aged 20-30 years) and nearly always alone (360/367, 98%).

unlisted_practices: Comparing consumer app versus developer API product-layer mediation on depiction of sensitive mental health content

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing how generative video model outputs on depression differ under consumer-app mediation versus raw API access, examining built-in safety/guardrail layers and narrative bias.

primary.practice: product-layer mediation / consumer app guardrails vs raw API
